purpose: Contract examples for human review and structural regression only; not render or art-quality proof.

cases.information_goal: establish the relationship between two people and one shared document
reveal a map route, enlarge one document detail, then compare a marker

natural_layer_motion_review_cases.given: Approved robe and cape separate clearly without paper borders.
natural_layer_motion_review_cases.expected: Reuse natural contours; no forced paper redesign or added outline.

natural_layer_motion_review_cases.given: Approved hair and cape already contain a paper-colored contour.
natural_layer_motion_review_cases.expected: Preserve the complete visible outline; do not clip or double it.

natural_layer_motion_review_cases.given: Clean background exists but feet remain truncated by an original rock occlusion.
natural_layer_motion_review_cases.expected: Keep the contact group or limit motion; do not invent feet or allow arbitrary drift.

natural_layer_motion_review_cases.given: A delayed stamp was removed only along its colored strokes.
natural_layer_motion_review_cases.expected: Repair the required contiguous region and inspect the empty pre-entrance plate; residual ghost is artifact.

natural_layer_motion_review_cases.given: All layers share exactly one transform although visible layer parallax is the declared goal.
natural_layer_motion_review_cases.expected: Review perceptible relative movement; shared zoom alone cannot prove the parallax goal.

natural_layer_motion_review_cases.given: The approved intent is continuous motion through the last frame but the final interval freezes.
natural_layer_motion_review_cases.expected: timing_failure; continue the declared movement through the last visible frame.

natural_layer_motion_review_cases.given: Numbers keep changing but a long ease-out looks stationary at target size.
natural_layer_motion_review_cases.expected: timing_failure when it defeats continuous-tail intent; pixel differences alone are insufficient.

natural_layer_motion_review_cases.given: The approved plan deliberately settles to let an evidence panel be read.
natural_layer_motion_review_cases.expected: Hold remains valid; do not apply a global never-stop rule.

natural_layer_motion_review_cases.given: Coverage and different last-frame pixels are recorded but final encoded viewing is missing.
natural_layer_motion_review_cases.expected: UNKNOWN for perceptual parallax and tail quality; no visual PASS or retry consumption.
